description: List your events, newest first, with dates, ticket types, pricing and capacity. Filter to upcoming events or events changed since a date. Paged (total/page/pageSize in the response). Humanitix: GET /v1/events.

in_future_only.description: Only events whose end date is in the future.

override_location.description: Query a region other than your account's own (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Humanitix stores data per region.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

since.description: Only results created/updated since this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

name: humanitix_list_events
title: List events
